peopleAlsoAsk: Is there meat in Thai green curry?
Is the taste of Thai green curry paste vegetarian?

items.markdown:
No, traditional Thai green curry is **not** vegetarian . Authentic recipes and curry pastes rely on shrimp paste and fish sauce for their savory, salty flavor.[](https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/) [[1]](https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/)[[2]](https://cookieandkate.com/thai-green-curry-with-spring-vegetables/)

To enjoy a vegetarian version, you must use a [vegan green curry paste](https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/) (which substitutes shrimp paste with ingredients like miso or soy sauce) and season the dish with soy sauce or vegan fish sauce instead of standard fish sauce. Many restaurants and home cooks adapt the dish easily by loading it with tofu, bamboo shoots, and vegetables.[](https://rainbowplantlife.com/vegan-thai-green-curry/) [[1]](https://hot-thai-kitchen.com/vegan-green-curry/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0lTQC6XXy7Q)[[3]](https://www.cubesnjuliennes.com/thai-curry-paste/)[[4]](https://thatspicychick.com/thai-green-curry-shrimp-lightened-up/)
